name: menu_equip_spare
doc: Stands in for saves/eq_spare.state where the generators need it (a bag holding gear Crono can wear, so A on a gear row opens the candidate list instead of the C2/9C8D empty-list buzz): at the fair merchant Crono buys one BronzeHelm (7D, 200 G -> 200 G left), leaves the shop and the merchant's line, and stands free under the tent. eq_spare's own bag (02 03 05 5B 5C 7C 95 96, 600 A.D.) is not reproduced; the Equip chrome does not depend on it.
